ModMetaData.name: Birth Quality Lifespan Fix
ModMetaData.author: SaltGin
ModMetaData.description:
Scales the mother's age bonus for birth quality based on race lifespan.
Long-lived races (like Milira, Dragonian, Miho, Moelotl, etc.) will now have their "prime birthing age" scaled proportionally to human equivalents.
Example: A 266-year-old pawn with a 1000-year lifespan will be treated as ~21 human years old for birth quality calculations, receiving the full +50% quality bonus.
